content.text:
exit=0
name: harbor-local
services:
  core:
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      registry:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      _REDIS_URL_CORE: redis://redis:6379/0
      _REDIS_URL_REG: redis://redis:6379/1
      CACHE_ENABLED: "true"
      CORE_SECRET: not-a-secret-only-for-local-development
      CORE_URL: http://core:8080
      EXT_ENDPOINT: http://localhost

observation.command: cd /workspace/deploy/compose/example/local && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env config >/tmp/compose-config.txt 2>/tmp/compose-config.err; echo "exit=$?"; tail -5 /tmp/compose-config.err; head -20 /tmp/compose-config.txt
